links.outcome: Diagnostic accuracy of multimodal LLMs compared with board-certified oral medicine experts on same lesions
links.effect: Experts had highest Top-1 accuracy (65.3%); ChatGPT-5 multimodal (Top-1 50.0%) approached expert-level performance at Top-3 and Top-5; Gemini showed limited benefit from images.
links.quote: Experts achieved the highest Top-1 accuracy (65.3%), but ChatGPT-5 multimodal outputs approached expert-level performance at Top-3 and Top-5.

unlisted_practices: Vision-weighted diagnostic gain metric to quantify the added value of image input in multimodal LLMs

screen.reason: The study evaluates diagnostic performance of multimodal LLMs (comparing text-only vs multimodal inputs) on a retrospective dataset of 150 biopsy-confirmed oral lesions compared to experts, but does not test an organizational deployment practice or guardrail.
